requests.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original transparent illustration for a 16:9 Chinese observation explainer, NOT a finished slide. Primary request: exactly two separate green leaves, arranged side by side with generous clean spacing, a broad rounded leaf on the left and a slender lanceolate leaf on the right. Both leaves point upward with short stems downward; a visible central vein and several natural branching veins. The rounded leaf has a gently scalloped outline; the narrow leaf has a smooth outline. Fictional generic leaves, no species labels and no claim of scientific specimen accuracy. Style: refined field-guide gouache and colored-pencil illustration with delicate dark forest-green contours, subtle matte pigment, crisp legible veins, adult editorial quality rather than a cute sticker. Palette: varied muted forest and sage greens, restrained warm highlights. Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas, broad leaf centered around x=30%, narrow leaf around x=72%, leaf tips near y=12%, stems ending near y=88%; full silhouettes visible, ample gap between leaves. Background: genuinely transparent, no paper rectangle, no cast shadow. Do not include people, pots, arrows, circles, annotations, numerals, text, typography, logos, or watermarks. The two leaves are the entire asset; annotations will be drawn later by code.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original establishing-scene illustration for a 16:9 knowledge video, NOT a slide or UI. Primary request: a fictional East Asian mother and her young son quietly observing a small potted leafy plant together in a bright simple courtyard. Mother has a short dark bob, round thin glasses, a muted teal overshirt with rolled sleeves and navy trousers. Son has short slightly tousled dark hair, a mustard-ochre short-sleeved shirt and charcoal shorts. The child crouches and leans toward a broad rounded leaf while the mother kneels nearby, gently attentive rather than lecturing; both look at the plant. Include one broad rounded leaf and one slender leaf clearly visible on the plant, as a visual observation example. Style: sophisticated contemporary editorial gouache, matte flat color shapes, subtle brush texture, natural expressive silhouettes, calm visual storytelling, hand-painted human warmth, no thick black cartoon sticker outlines. Composition: panoramic 16:9, characters and planter occupy the center-right 65% of frame, whole bodies and pot visible; leftmost 25% kept airy for later titles, upper 15% clear for headers. Very simple pale cool-gray floor and almost-white background, a few restrained green foliage shapes suggesting the courtyard; no rendered text or graphic frames. Palette: deep teal, sage green, mustard, small terracotta accent, neutral light background. No words, numbers, labels, thought bubbles, arrows, logos, watermarks, camera border, page frames or collage panels. Make a single coherent scene with a stable sense of ground and space. Avoid exaggerated baby proportions and stock clipart.
